subject: VPC & on‑prem architecture review — scheduling a technical deep dive

Subject: VPC & on‑prem architecture review — scheduling a technical deep dive

Hi Sasha / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the discovery call earlier today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed next step:

What we heard
- Primary goal: run Redwoods-hosted inference in a customer-managed VPC or fully on-prem for regulated workloads (payment data).
- Key constraints: strict egress controls, FIPS-backed KMS integration, 3rd-party HSM for key material, and a requirement for audit logs retention for 2 years.
- Expected scale: pilot with ~5 concurrent inference nodes, then ramp to ~40 over 6–9 months.

Next step (technical deep dive)
We recommend a 60–90 minute architecture review with our Solutions Architect (rishi_malhotra) and Infra Lead (vivek_kulkarni). Agenda we suggest:
1) Deep dive into Acme network topology and egress/security posture
2) VPC peering / PrivateLink vs on-prem connectivity options
3) KMS/HSM integrations and key rotation model
4) Performance expectations and initial capacity plan
5) Required artifacts & integration checklist (network ranges, proxy rules, security questionnaire)

Proposed times (PT):
- Tue Apr 14, 10:00–11:30am PT
- Wed Apr 15, 2:00–3:30pm PT

I attached a short requirements checklist (redwood_vpc_requirements_v1.pdf) and a network sketch to make the call efficient. Can you confirm which time works or share 2 windows that fit your team? Also let me know if you want procurement/security on the call — we can loop them in or run a separate sync.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning calendars.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Hi Sasha / Tom —

Thanks for the availability. We can do Tue Apr 14 at 11:00 PT — that works for me and Vivek. For the call to be productive, a couple of asks up front:
- Can you share your public network ranges and whether you support PrivateLink or require IP allowlists?
- If you plan to use an on-prem option, please indicate whether you have an existing VPN concentrator or an appliance we should model against.
- Please send any red-team or external pen-test timelines we should be aware of (affects rollout gating).

Tentative agenda (90m):
1) 5m intros / outcomes
2) 20m Acme network & security posture (Tom)
3) 30m Redwood architecture options (VPC peering, PrivateLink, mutual TLS, on-prem package)
4) 20m KMS/HSM & key-management patterns (including rotation & bring-your-own-key flow)
5) 10m next steps / owners / timeline

I'll bring a short slide that maps our typical deployment patterns to the checklist Marissa attached. If you can upload the network ranges and a sanitized topology to the Drive link I shared, that will let us finalize recommendations during the call.

Cheers,
